# Vendor CAD

`pendulum_rig.scad` takes its servo dimensions from Waveshare's SC15 drawings
(STEP and DXF, `SC15-Servo.zip`), downloadable from the SC15 page of the
Waveshare wiki. They are not included here: Waveshare publishes them without
a licence that would allow redistribution under this repo's terms. Unzip them
into `sc15_cad/` for reference; nothing in the build reads them.
